Title: Azure AD Conditional Access policy for the combined MFA and password reset security info registration experience

Body.Content:
Control the conditions in which sensitive security information for multi-factor authentication and self-service password reset can be registered.  Apply Azure AD Conditional access policies to ensure users are on a trusted network, users have low sign-in risk, users register on a managed device, or users have agreed to the registration terms-of-use.

Read the tech community blog to learn more.
